integrity: Proof uses explicit Gram-spectrum calculation, a complete finite exact-rational positivity certificate, and a directly attained positive eigenvector. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for the centered graph-ball maximal operator on the unweighted four-cycle with counting measure in real ell^2. The finite rational certificate is exhaustive for its 81 radius patterns; broader graphs, weighted norms, and other exponents are not claimed. Earlier unindexed equivalent calculations remain possible.
title: Exact strong \(\ell^2\) norm and all extremizers of the centered maximal operator on the four-cycle
